subject: [DOCS] add author (#207)
body: This PR adds author to the conf.py so docs can render authors correctly
diff:
diff --git a/docs/conf.py b/docs/conf.py
index 7118b41..ef0f399 100644
--- a/docs/conf.py
+++ b/docs/conf.py
@@ -49,6 +49,8 @@ __version__ = setuptools_scm.get_version(root="..")
 
 project = "tvm-ffi"
 
+author = "Apache TVM FFI contributors"
+
 version = __version__
 release = __version__
